corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 6th-order ግ in ከግብርናተ ዲያብሎስ ('from the servitude of the devil', matching the previous page ending), misread as ባ due to ink fill in the upper loop.
Classical Ge'ez infinitive construct ሐይወ ከመ መላእክት ('living like the angels'); a tiny ink speck next to 1st-order ወ caused it to be misread as ዉ.

Both the printed glyph at the end of the line (symmetric two-legged 1st-order ለ without a top-left hook) and Amharic passive-jussive morphology require ትገለጽልን ('that it be revealed to us'), not ትገልጽልን.
